## Deviations / limits

- **Size:** ~1.7k changed source/test lines vs ≤1400 — recorded
  (AMEND precedent, as R6.17/R6.22/R6.23); the three renderers share
  one module, so the two contract stages landed in one commit rather
  than an artificial file split.
- **Stage boundary:** items 1–8 (CHAT-PY+CHAT-NODE) and 9–10
  (MESSAGES) landed in a single code commit; the renderers share
  `render.rs` — recorded, not split.
- Rendered files are slot-invariant by construction (token in env/
  argv-`$VAR` references only; the instruction rides argv/env, never
  the files) — this is what makes `template_hash` a per-admission
  constant.
- `.claude.json` carries `{"hasCompletedOnboarding":true}` — a real
  Claude state key; the adapter writes that file only for MCP, so the
  seed is the HH-declared member under `rendered_paths` (prevents an
  interactive onboarding prompt in the closed cell).
- Claude's instruction-var suffix derives from `sha256(slot_id)`
  (the adapter's uuid-hex shape, deterministic per slot); O's uuid
  differs anyway and R-replay masks ids.
- HH's O surface passes the key by name (`--api-key-name`) so the
  adapters' env-var key channels fire — consumed by R6.26's job config
  (recorded; the Pi adapter *requires* an env key reference for
  custom endpoints).
- Everything is `fixture-verified`/offline — no live run, no image,
  no spend ($0.00).
